info.name: Glowora Booking API - Role Workflows
info.description:
One collection organized by real user roles and jobs.

Run order:
00 Shared Setup creates fresh test users and tokens.
01 Shop Owner creates the store shell.
02 Super Admin approves the store.
03 Shop Owner builds catalog and invites staff.
04 Shop Staff accepts invite and manages booking work.
05 Customer browses, books, pays, reviews, chats.
06 Super Admin moderates review after customer review exists.
07 Public Read APIs can be run after store is approved.

Use one environment only: test/glowora-local.postman_environment.json.
Seed requirements: pnpm run db:seed. Demo seed is optional: pnpm run db:seed:demo. Location seed is optional for /locations checks: pnpm exec prisma db execute --file prisma/seed_provinces_wards.sql.

item.name: 08 - TELEGRAM & CHAT: Full Integration Flow
item.description:
End-to-end Telegram and chat integration tests.

Run order:
08.01 Owner links a Telegram supergroup to the store (group topic path).
08.02 Staff generates a fresh Telegram link token.
08.03 Simulate staff clicking the /start deep link — sets Staff.telegramChatId in the DB.
08.04 Staff views all store conversations.
08.05 Customer reads their conversation with all embedded messages.
08.06 Staff fetches paginated messages for the same conversation.
08.07 Staff marks a specific message as read (skipped automatically if no messageId is saved).
08.08 Owner unlinks the Telegram group (cleanup).

Pre-conditions: Sections 00–05 must have run successfully (storeId, ownerToken, staffToken, customerToken, staffId, conversationId must be set).

NOTE on WebSocket: Sending messages (customer→app and Telegram reply→WebSocket broadcast) requires a WebSocket client. In Postman use the WebSocket request tab:
  URL: ws://localhost:8080
  Auth header: Authorization: Bearer {{customerToken}}
  Events: join_conversation {conversationId}, send_message {conversationId, content}

item.name: 08.01 Owner - link Telegram supergroup to store
item.description:
Links a Telegram supergroup (forum/Topics mode) to the store. Customer messages will be forwarded to this group as individual topic threads.

Production setup:
1. Create a Telegram supergroup.
2. Enable Topics: Group Settings → Topics → on.
3. Add the bot as admin with 'Manage Topics' permission.
4. Get the group ID (format: -100xxxxxxxxxx) from the bot or via getUpdates.

For local testing a placeholder ID is used — the API call succeeds (DB updated) but Telegram forwarding requires a real group.

item.name: 08.02 Staff - generate Telegram link token
item.description:
Generates a new one-time deep-link token for the staff member. The returned linkUrl is what the staff opens in Telegram to connect their account.

Format: https://t.me/<BotName>?start=<token>

Clicking this URL opens a Telegram chat with the bot and auto-sends /start <token>. The webhook (08.03) then links the staff's Telegram chatId.

Dependency: staffToken and storeId must be set (sections 00 and 04).

item.name: 08.03 Simulate - Staff links Telegram account (/start webhook)
item.description:
Simulates the Telegram webhook payload Telegram sends when a staff member opens the deep link and starts the bot.

What happens after this call:
- Staff.telegramChatId = 100100100 (the fake chatId in the payload)
- Staff.telegramLinkToken = null (consumed)
- The bot attempts to send a confirmation DM (fails in dev without a real bot token, but the DB update succeeds)

In production Telegram sends this automatically — you do not call /telegram/webhook yourself.

Dependency: staffTelegramToken must be set from 08.02 (or 04.06).

item.name: 08.04 Staff - list store conversations
item.description:
Staff sees all conversations for their store, ordered by most recent message (lastMessageAt desc).

Each conversation item includes: id, customerId, storeId, mode, lastMessageAt, lastMessageBody, _count.messages, customer info.

Requires CONVERSATION.VIEW permission (granted to SHOP_STAFF and SHOP_OWNER).

exec: pm.test('Response has items and total', function () {

item.name: 08.08 Owner - unlink Telegram group from store (cleanup)
item.description:
Removes the Telegram group link from the store (sets Store.telegramGroupId = null).

After this, new customer messages will fall back to the DM path:
- The assigned staff member receives a Telegram DM from the bot
- Staff replies in DM → bot relays back to the conversation

Run this to clean up after testing the group topic path.
